name: Air Fryer BBQ Chicken Tenders with Slaw and Potato Wedges

components.name: BBQ Chicken Tenders
steps: Set up beaten egg and panko-breadcrumb stations. Season raw tenders, coat in egg, then press into breadcrumb mix.
Preheat air fryer to 200 C. Spray coated chicken and air fry in batches, turning after approximately 5-6 minutes; check 74 C and brush with barbecue sauce only once cooked.
Divide cooked chicken and wedges into four meals; combine with dressed slaw when ready to eat and re-crisp chicken in air fryer if possible.

components.name: Potato Wedges
steps: Coat potato wedges with their oil and paprika. Air fry after chicken or on a second batch for approximately 18-23 minutes, turning.

components.name: Yogurt Slaw
steps: Combine raw cabbage and carrot and pack separately; mix Greek yogurt and vinegar into a slaw dressing, also chilled separately.
